frida: Quick experiment idea — run an A/B on pin tiers to measure ops overhead vs retention. Short hypothesis: 60d managed pins reduce migration support tickets by 40% vs 14d soft-pins, but increase infra uplift.
nate: Nice. Metrics to capture: ticket_count per customer, avg time-to-rollback, reserved_uptime_pct, and per-token COGS. Keep sample size small (10 customers) for pilot.
sofia: ML side: we'll keep bench pass constant. Add a "pin_cohort" label to eval runs so we can slice quality drift by cohort. Also run a drift detector weekly.
lee: Ops: need to model reserved pool cost per cohort. For the pilot assume +18% uplift for managed pins. Also require a rollback playbook per cohort.
karen: Product: we'll include a short consent banner for customers during pilot explaining pin options and a rollback SLA. Draft comms later today.
ci-bot: Triggered: ab-test-create -> cohortA(14d), cohortB(60d) scheduled 2024-09-03T12:00Z. Bench gating required.
frida: Action items: nate owns metrics dashboard, sofia hooks pin_cohort into bench harness, lee writes rollback playbook, karen drafts comms. Decision review in 1 week.
frida: Thanks all — keep notes tidy, we'll use results to set default pin at GA. :raised_hands:
